model: resnet50 (torchvision IMAGENET1K_V2, FP32, ONNX Runtime 1.26.0 CUDA EP)
inputs: prepared ImageNet validation subset, images 0..N-1 in file order, the same images for every run of a size; the images of a smaller size are a prefix of the larger ones
service_time_definition: batch assembly + tensor setup + session.Run; model loading, image loading and warm-up excluded; no logits copied, no per-run console output
throughput_definition: batch_size / mean service time of back-to-back batches (observed sequential rate), not serving throughput with arriving traffic
percentile_note: P95 of 10 runs is linearly interpolated between the two largest values and is close to the maximum
gpu_memory_note: whole-GPU memory.used from nvidia-smi sampled about every 100 ms (WDDM, other processes included); sampled value, not an exact peak
